crossRefs.note: My son, listen to your father’s instruction, and don’t forsake your mother’s teaching:
My son, don’t forget my teaching; but let your heart keep my commandments:
Those in the good ground, these are those who with an honest and good heart, having heard the word, hold it tightly…
But he said, “On the contrary, blessed are those who hear the word of God, and keep it.”
Jesus answered him, “If a man loves me, he will keep my word. My Father will love him, and we will come to him, and…
Remember the word that I said to you: ‘A servant is not greater than his lord.’ If they persecuted me, they will also…
Blessed is he who reads and those who hear the words of the prophecy, and keep the things that are written in it, for…
He said to me, “See you don’t do it! I am a fellow bondservant with you and with your brothers, the prophets, and with…
My son, if you will receive my words, and store up my commandments within you,
Wise men lay up knowledge, but the mouth of the foolish is near ruin.
and the curse, if you do not listen to the commandments of Yahweh your God, but turn away out of the way which I…
Please receive instruction from his mouth, and lay up his words in your heart.

translations.web: My son, keep my words. Lay up my commandments within you.
translations.bsb: My son, keep my words and treasure my commandments within you.
translations.kjv: My son, keep my words, and lay up my commandments
translations.asv: My son, keep my words, And lay up my commandments with thee.
